Hyderabad Police Arrest Individuals in Separate Cases

Hyderabad police have made arrests in two separate incidents. In one case, six individuals were apprehended for attempting to sell a fake Panchaloha idol. In a separate operation, three people were arrested in connection with an illegal Mephentermine racket. The specific details regarding the fake idol case mention it was a 'fake Lakshmi idol, stone'.
